q.g: Contrary to the quest objectives, in this quest you have to stash MS2000 Markers at 3 medical containers on Shoreline. They are located next to Sanitar's treatment locations from the quest Anesthesia. The markers can be stashed in any order over any number of raids.

sh.c: #1: Next to the ambulance at the resort
#2: In the backyard of the locked cottage
#3: In front of the office building at the pier
